nodes.title: Red Retro Music Poster
nodes.descriptionHtml:
This vertical framed poster brings bold, gallery-quality presence to any indoor wall. Printed on archival museum-grade paper with vivid pigment inks, the artwork keeps its deep reds and fine detail fresh for years. Each piece is finished with a matte premium surface and protected behind clear plexiglass, then set into a slim wooden frame (choose black or white) with pre-installed hanging hardware for an easy, professional display. Multiple sizes available so you can scale the composition to a hallway, living room, or studio wall.

Product features
- Museum-grade archival paper resists yellowing
- Vivid pigment inks for bright, lasting color
- Slim wooden frame available in black or white
- Matte premium paper with plexiglass front for protection
- Pre-installed hanging hardware; multiple sizes for flexible display

Care instructions
- If the poster does gather any dust, you may wipe it off gently with a clean, dry cloth. To remove spots or smudges from acrylic or glass, we recommend applying glass cleaner to a clean, soft, dry cloth or paper towel and then to the surface so that the cleaner does not settle on the frame, then buff the surface dry to remove any streaks.
